# Mary Vance

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P1](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hopetown Orphan Asylum / Over-harbour  <sub>[v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051), [v5 c5 P52](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** Adopted ward and household helper to Miss Cornelia Bryant  <sub>[v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c9 P46](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary Vance has a thin, freckled, sunburned face with a wide mouth and very pale, bright eyes described as 'white eyes' with a narrow black ring around the iris. She has long, lank, tow-colored hair worn in braids, white teeth, and chapped, work-hardened hands. After being taken in by Miss Cornelia, she becomes plump and rosy, dressing proudly in new clothes such as a blue velvet cap with a red rosette, a navy blue coat, and a squirrel-fur muff.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P5](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0005), [v5 c5 P6](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0006), [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028), [v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c18 P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005)_

## Personality

Mary Vance is loud, outspoken, boastful, and fiercely independent, with a sharp tongue and a habit of expressing herself in slang and mild profanity. Having been abused and starved in her past, she is tough, practical, and highly sensitive about being pitied or looked down upon. Despite her sharp, gossipy nature and propensity to tell wild tales, she is intensely loyal to those who show her kindness, fiercely energetic, and takes pride in being a hard worker.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P22](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0022), [v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035), [v5 c5 P48](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0048), [v5 c5 P58](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0058), [v5 c5 P63](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0063), [v5 c5 P75](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0075), [v5 c5 P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106), [v5 c5 P125](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0125), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c9 P48](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0048), [v5 c18 P13](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0013)_

## History

Mary Vance ran away from her abusive guardian, Mrs. Wiley, after losing her saved money, and hid in James Taylor's old hay barn near Glen St. Mary. She was discovered starving by the Meredith children, who brought her secretly to the manse, fed her, and sheltered her in the garret. She quickly proved herself a capable helper, taking over household chores in the manse. When Mrs. Wiley suddenly died, Mary faced the prospect of being sent back to the Hopetown Orphan Asylum. Una Meredith, touched by Mary's fear of returning to the orphan asylum, begged Miss Cornelia Bryant to take her in. Miss Cornelia adopted Mary, bringing her into a comfortable home where she was well-clad and cared for. Mary quickly adapted to her new life, becoming a devoted helper to Miss Cornelia and a prominent, chatter-filled companion to the Meredith and Blythe children in Rainbow Valley.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P8](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0008), [v5 c5 P15](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0015), [v5 c5 P26](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0026), [v5 c5 P37](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0037), [v5 c5 P95](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0095), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c8 P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039), [v5 c8 P43](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0043), [v5 c9 P18](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0018), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c9 P49](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0049), [v5 c18 P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000)_

- Daughter of parents who died due to alcoholism  <sub>[v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053), [v5 c5 P55](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0055)</sub>

- Severely abused, starved, and overworked for four years by her guardian, Mrs. Wiley  <sub>[v5 c5 P33](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0033), [v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035), [v5 c5 P47](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0047), [v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051)</sub>
